detailed_description: WebSocket Tester is a powerful online tool for testing and debugging WebSocket connections in real-time. It allows developers to connect to any WebSocket server, send messages, and view incoming responses instantly. The tool supports the standard WebSocket protocol (ws:// and wss://), making it perfect for testing chat applications, live data feeds, gaming servers, and other real-time communication systems. With features like connection status monitoring, message history, and quick connect to test servers, this tool is essential for any developer working with WebSocket-based applications. All testing happens directly in your browser with no data sent to external servers.
usage_steps: Enter the WebSocket server URL (ws:// or wss://)
Click Connect to establish the WebSocket connection
Type your message in the input field
Click Send to transmit the message to the server
View received messages in the message history panel
usage_examples: Test WebSocket echo servers to verify connection functionality
Debug real-time chat application message handling
Monitor live data feeds from WebSocket APIs
Verify WebSocket server responses during development
